title: Create booking (checkout hand-off) — tool input (arguments of tools/call)
description: The `inputSchema` of the `create_booking` MCP tool: what the model sends. Both servers must declare exactly this. READ-ONLY: nothing is reserved, held or paid; the tool re-checks availability and returns a summary the widget turns into a discoverasr.com checkout link (README). PRD T-08 §5, with the guests and the room + rate given PER ROOM in `apartmentList` (as T-04 0.3.0, Figma MVP 1630:50627 books several rooms; PRD EC-06 is superseded, README decision 2). Left out: `memberId` (anonymous MVP) and `enrollAsrOnCheckout` (the MVP has no enrolment checkbox, decision 6). 0.1.0, provisional (2026-10-28).

propertyCode.description: The property's code, e.g. "51052". Carried from a get_room_rate_details / compare_rooms_rates result (`meta.property_code`), or resolved from the property name the user gives (PRD ER-01).

checkinDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Carried from the get_room_rate_details context when present. Server default when omitted: 30 days from today (PRD §5). Must be before `checkoutDate` (enforced by the server).

checkoutDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, after `checkinDate`. Server default when omitted: the day after check-in (PRD §5: 31 days from today).

apartmentList.description: One entry per room to book, in the user's order (upstream's `apartmentList`, as get_room_rate_details). Default when omitted: one room for 1 adult, the cheapest room and rate. Each entry's guests, and its `roomCode` + `ratePlanCode` when the user picked them (from a get_room_rate_details / compare_rooms_rates result: the room's `room_code` and the rate's `rate_plan_code` for THAT requested room). Without them the server picks that room's cheapest room type and rate (PRD AC-02). Carry the same guests per room as the room-rate search; for several rooms, if the user has not said how the guests are split, ask before calling.

noOfadults.description: Adults in this room; at least 1.

childAges.description: Each child's age in years, one per child: its length MUST equal `noOfchildren` (`[]` when none). If the user mentions children but not their ages, ASK before calling; never guess them.

roomCode.description: The room type to book: a `room_code` from get_room_rate_details, e.g. "0BRCT". With `ratePlanCode`, or neither.

ratePlanCode.description: The rate to book: that room's `rate_plan_code`, e.g. "ZZFLEX". With `roomCode`, or neither.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217; every price in the response uses it (AC-07). Carried from the context. Server default when omitted: the property's own currency, as T-04.

voucherCode.description: A promotion or voucher code the user gave, or one from a get_promotions result (PRD `voucherCode` / `promotionCode`). Passed to upstream; whether it was accepted comes back in `meta.voucher_code_valid`.

language.description: The language the user is writing in, set by the model and never asked of the user: a BCP 47 tag from this list. Omit for any other language, or when unsure. The widget shows its own UI text and website links in it; property data (names, descriptions) stays in the API's language for now. Servers accept it and pass it through untouched. Same field and values as T-01 to T-07.
